subject: POC Observability Plan & Next Steps - FinTechX
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@fintechx.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 15:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + POC observability questions

Thanks Alex - great conversation today. Quick recap and a few follow-ups from our side so we can scope the POC observability work: 

Summary of call:
- FinTechX is evaluating Redwood Dedicated for a two-week POC focused on production observability and cost/latency profiling for your payments pipeline.
- Primary goals: validate traceability across request routing, get per-request token/latency breakdowns, and measure caching impact on cost.

Open questions (please confirm):
- Which environment should we target for metrics export? (S3 bucket vs. your internal logging stack)
- Do you have an existing Prometheus/Grafana and OpenTelemetry collector we should send to, or should we spin up temporary endpoints?
- Success criteria: is the primary metric latency (p95) or cost per 1k requests, or both?

Proposed next steps:
1) I'll share an observability checklist and a proposed evaluation plan (attached).
2) Schedule a 30-min kickoff next week to align on access & timeline.
3) Jordan will pair with your infra lead for tracing instrumentation; Marcus will own dashboard templates.

Attachments: redwood-poc-observability-checklist.pdf (checklist + dashboard templates)

If that all looks good I'll lock a kickoff for Mon Aug 24.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@fintechx.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + POC observability questions

Thanks Marissa - appreciate the recap. Quick answers: 
- Export target: prefer S3 for raw logs + Prometheus pushgateway for metrics. We can provide an S3 bucket with temp credentials.
- We have an OpenTelemetry collector in our staging VPC (collector.staging.fintechx.internal). Would you be able to send OTLP traces there?
- Success criteria: primary = reliability/traceability (end-to-end trace across gateway -> routing -> model), secondary = latency p95 and cost per 1k tokens. If we can get a per-request breakdown (latency, model version, tokens billed, cache hit/miss) that should be sufficient.

A couple clarifying items:
- Can your runtime add a request_id header that propagates through the trace? We need consistent correlation IDs for our logs.
- For sampling: would you recommend full traces for the POC or 100% traces for a bounded traffic sample?

I can loop in our infra lead (Sara) and security for S3 creds once we schedule the kickoff. Kickoff window Aug 24-26 works.

- Alex
Head of Platform Engineering | FinTechX
alex.chen@fintechx.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@fintechx.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 12:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + POC observability questions

Thanks Alex - sounds good. Attached is the POC Observability Checklist (PDF) and our proposed Method of Procedure (MOP) draft (DOCX). High level POC plan below: 

POC scope (2 weeks):
- Instrumentation: enable OpenTelemetry OTLP forwarding from your staging to the collector endpoint; Redwood runtime will emit traces with request_id and model metadata.
- Metrics & logs: export Prometheus metrics (per-route latency histograms, token counters, cache_hit_rate) and raw logs to S3 (parsing-ready JSON).
- Dashboards: we'll provide Grafana dashboards showing p50/p95 latency, error rate, tokens per request, model version distribution, cache hit rate, throughput (rps), and per-route cost estimate.
- Tracing: end-to-end traces (gateway -> routing -> model) with clickable spans and trace links in the dashboard.

Success criteria (please confirm/edit):
1) Traces available and correlated with logs for 90% of sampled requests in the POC window.
2) p95 latency for production-like sample workload <= 500ms (goal 350ms) for 95% of requests routed to the selected model variant.
3) Per-request token & cost breakdown exported to S3 and visible in the dashboard for the sampled traffic.
4) Cache hit rate observed and measured; expected hit rate >= 20% for warm prefixes (if you have repetitive traffic).

Evaluation plan / deliverables:
- Week 0 (pre-kickoff): access & creds, sample traffic plan, list of endpoints to instrument.
- Week 1: instrumentation + baseline metrics + initial dashboards.
- Week 2: stress runs, cost profiling, and a final review (presentation + recommendations).

Ownership:
- FinTechX: provide S3 bucket, OTLP endpoint, access for Jordan and Marcus, and supply sample traffic keys.
- Redwood: Jordan (tracing instrumentation lead), Marcus (dashboard + metrics), Marissa (project owner & final review).

Next steps:
- Confirm success criteria above.
- Share S3 bucket details and OTLP collector host.
- Kickoff on Mon Aug 24 10:00am PT? (we can adjust)

Attachments: redwood-poc-observability-checklist.pdf; fintechx-poc-mop.docx

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@fintechx.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + POC observability questions

On it - I'll own the OTLP integration and request_id propagation. Quick notes for FinTechX infra team: 
- We recommend full traces for a bounded sampling window (e.g., 1000 requests) to validate spans and correlation, then switch to a 10% sample for steady-state.
- Request_id header: we'll add X-Redwood-Request-Id and map it to trace_id in Otel spans. Please make sure your gateway forwards that header.
- Prom metrics we'll emit: redwood_request_latency_seconds (histogram), redwood_tokens_total (counter, labels=model_version, route), redwood_cache_hit_ratio (gauge), redwood_inference_errors_total (counter).

I'll prepare a short instrumentation runbook and share before kickoff. Marcus - I'll need your Grafana panel templates so I can wire the spans/metrics links.

- Jordan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@fintechx.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Sara Lim <sara.lim@fintechx.com>, security@fintechx.com
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 16:35:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + POC observability questions

All right - this looks good. Confirming:
- Kickoff: Mon Aug 24 10:00am PT (calendar invite incoming).
- We will create an S3 bucket and share temporary creds with security; OTLP collector host will be reachable from staging.
- Success criteria confirmed as listed (we may tighten the p95 target after baseline).

Next actions for my team:
- Sara will coordinate S3 creds and security review (cc'd).
- I will share the gateway config to accept X-Redwood-Request-Id and allow OTLP from Redwood IPs during the POC window.

Thanks - looking forward to kickoff.

Cheers,
Alex
Head of Platform Engineering | FinTechX
